title: exaBITS AI
tagline: exaBITS AI is a decentralized AI-generation NFT platform. The platform runs on a physically decentralized cloud called exaBTIS.
description:
exaBITS AI is an NFT generation platform based on AI. It runs on exaBTIS Cloud - a physically decentralized cloud powered by blockchain.

The AI algorithm runs on distributed computing nodes of the exaBITS Cloud, with the data of NFT decentralizedly stored in the nodes as well. The tokens of NFTs are minted on Ethereum. 

The exaBITS Cloud is leveraging web3 model (like Helium) to provide Alchemy and cloud infrastructure services. Consumers use exaBITS Computing Machines to contribute computing power to a pooled computing network and generate passive income. 

Developers and enterprises obtain computation on demand from exaBITS Cloud that is safer, cheaper and faster than the offerings of leading cloud providers.

Team members come from Harvard, Princeton, UC Berkeley, UCSD, DCU, with experiences working at Helium, Microsoft, Facebook, Snapchat, Motorola, NBA, Public Blockchain and a Mining Machine Manufacturer.
how_its_made:
The exaBITS Cloud is built by distributed computing nodes adopted by people at their homes and offices. The Ethereum blockchain is leveraged to organize these nodes and validate their contributions.

The exaBITS AI is built on top of the exaBITS Cloud with frontend and backend run on the distributed computing nodes. NFT is stored by exaBITS Cloud's distributed storage.

The NFT tokens of the exaBITS AI Platform are minted on Ethereum.

The NFT-generation AI is based on AI-Art, an open-source AI algorithm using VQGAN + CLIP using docker containers. The docker containers are uploaded and run on exaBITS Cloud.
